craft_color_lights: Polished metal, radiating heat and light
witness_quote_summary: Officer Lonnie Zamora observed a landed egg-shaped craft and two small figures in white suits; the craft later ascended with a burst of light.
fbi_response_summary: The Bureau maintains no information identifiable with the correspondent and refers matters to the Air Force.

witness_quote_summary: Witness James C. Collins claimed to be taken into a transparent oblong craft manned by small human-like creatures in t-shirts and trousers.
fbi_response_summary: Standard dismissal stating UFO investigations are not within the investigative jurisdiction of the FBI; referred to the Air Force.

craft_color_lights: Metallic, radio controlled, jet engines around the exterior
witness_quote_summary: Former Luftwaffe pilot Paul L. Peyerl reported photographing a 21-foot diameter saucer craft developed by German engineers in the Black Forest.
fbi_response_summary: Information submitted to the Bureau for consideration of transmittal to the U.S. Air Force.

craft_color_lights: Metallic substance and color, jagged on one side
witness_quote_summary: A 13x8x5 inch metallic object with an internal heat source fell from the sky and was recovered by local police.
fbi_response_summary: Relayed information to the National Military Command Center and suggested contact with the Milwaukee Police Department.

witness_quote_summary: Police followed a brilliantly lighted saucer-shaped object for 85 miles across the Ohio/Pennsylvania border.
fbi_response_summary: The FBI stated that the matter is outside their jurisdiction and the photograph mentioned did not represent FBI employees.

witness_quote_summary: Witness Edward A. Stewart Jr. claimed an unusual object laying air mines was responsible for the mid-air explosion of Pan American Flight N709PA.
fbi_response_summary: The FBI referred the witness to reports from the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) attributing the crash to lightning.

witness_quote_summary: W.R. Hanawalt reported seeing unidentified flying objects during combat missions in 1945 and suggested a 'cobalt ray' was involved.
fbi_response_summary: Bureau indices contain no information identifiable with the correspondent; files maintained as confidential.

craft_color_lights: Blue-yellow bars of light, like neon lamps
witness_quote_summary: Intriguing blue-yellow lights described as 'neon lamps dangling in the sky' were spotted 15 miles south of Ann Arbor.
fbi_response_summary: Information made a matter of record; standard referral to the Air Force.

witness_quote_summary: A 'glowing blue thing' exploded and lit up the town like a giant flashbulb.
fbi_response_summary: The FBI noted the report but deferred to Air Force Project Blue Book conclusions.

witness_quote_summary: Witnesses observed a red and green light hovering over a tall tree that then sped away.
fbi_response_summary: Enclosed standard materials on the FBI and acknowledged receipt of the report.

witness_quote_summary: Informant claimed a UFO was detected over the 'Dewline' and shot down, with extraterrestrials attempting to recover it.
fbi_response_summary: Document contained no recommendations or conclusions; distributed to Air Force and OSI.

witness_quote_summary: An antimissile missile was allegedly fired at a UFO over Africa; the craft was reportedly protected by a force field.
fbi_response_summary: Standard intelligence distribution to military agencies.
